headline.text: L1 S2 jar line held for *X-ray failure* — test cards not detected, product re-inspection underway.

summary: One active hold at L1 S2 after X-ray system failed to detect test cards at startup; Troy repaired and verified 30 consecutive passes, 100% of suspect product undergoing re-inspection. Three foreign material flags today: L3 ML4 found cookie pieces in a cleaned sweco before installation, L1 S4 belt lamination peeling at seam, and cardboard box staged in L1 S4 open production area.

holds.title: S2 jar line X-ray failure — product held for re-inspection
holds.summary: X-ray system failed to detect test cards correctly at startup; maintenance repaired and re-verified, 100% of product that passed through during the fault window is being re-inspected through the X-ray before QA release.
holds.status: On hold pending completion of 100% re-inspection and QA disposition.

food_safety.title: S4 THG belt lamination peeling at seam
food_safety.summary: Lamination coming off THG Belt #1 where it was seamed, creating potential foreign material risk; Lolo trimmed the sticking area, sanitized, and released to operations; maintenance aware of ongoing belt issue.
food_safety.status: Trimmed and sanitized for continued use; maintenance tracking for replacement.

food_safety.title: Foreign material found in cleaned sweco before installation
food_safety.summary: ML4 crew found cookie pieces inside a north sweco screen that had passed ATP and visual inspection; Kevin inspected and confirmed cookie pieces, equipment operator cleaned and removed all pieces before installing.
food_safety.status: Resolved — foreign material removed before equipment placed in service.

food_safety.title: Cardboard box in S4 open production area
food_safety.summary: Mary flagged cardboard box in open candy production area as foreign material risk and requested removal.

sanitation.title: S2 product left on line and printers running over weekend
sanitation.summary: Day shift found final product left on S2 line and Matrix 6-8 printers not shut down over weekend; Brandon clarified product was intentionally held pending Monday order decision but printers should have been off.
sanitation.status: Resolved for this instance; supervisor coaching overnight team on shutdown procedures.

sanitation.title: S1 kitchen area dirty after overnight shift
sanitation.summary: S1 Kitchen found dirty with sticky floor at day-shift startup; butter system was off and coconut hose not cleaned, both frozen; Brandon confirmed will address with overnight team.
sanitation.status: Resolved for production; supervisor follow-up scheduled with overnight crew.

sanitation.title: S1 kettles overflowed and burned after caustic wash
sanitation.summary: Marcos found recently washed kettles with burned material on outside, indicating overflow during or after caustic cleaning; root cause under investigation.
sanitation.status: Open — investigation ongoing with kitchen and sanitation teams.

sanitation.title: No hot water in wash area 2 during production
sanitation.summary: Dishwashing area 2 lost hot water supply; maintenance investigation found plant-wide hot water demand exceeded boiler capacity, starving sanitation areas.
sanitation.status: Root cause identified as capacity constraint; production adjusting usage to restore sanitation supply.

sanitation.title: S3 butter tank heating plate dirty
sanitation.summary: Katya and maintenance found butter tank heating plate dirty while troubleshooting non-working heater; circuit breaker had tripped.
sanitation.status: Heating resolved via breaker reset; plate cleanliness flagged for sanitation follow-up.

opportunities.text: Review weekend shutdown checklist to explicitly include product removal and printer shutdown verification — based on S2 product and running printers found Monday morning.
Consider installing flow monitors or low-pressure alarms on dishwashing hot water supply — based on today's discovery that production demand starved wash area 2 without immediate detection.

Consider adding a final visual inspection immediately before equipment installation, even after cleaning verification passes — based on ML4 sweco foreign material that bypassed ATP and initial visual checks.
